question: How many customers are there?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: How many products are there?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products

question: What is the most expensive product?
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the cheapest product?
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1

question: List all customers from Pune
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE LOWER(city) LIKE '%pune%'

question: Show products in the Fitness category
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE LOWER(category) LIKE '%fitness%'

question: List products priced under 1000
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price < 1000

question: How many orders were cancelled?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'CANCELLED'

question: How many orders are pending?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'PENDING'

question: List customers whose name starts with A
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE 'a%'

question: Show all orders placed by Aarav Sharma
expected_sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_date, o.status FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%aarav sharma%'

question: Which products did Priya Desai order?
expected_sql: SELECT p.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%priya desai%'

question: How many orders has each customer placed?
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

question: What is the total revenue from delivered orders?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'DELIVERED'

question: What is the total revenue by city?
expected_sql: SELECT c.city, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'DELIVERED' GROUP BY c.city

question: Which customer has placed the most orders?
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 3 best-selling products by quantity?
expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which customers have never placed an order?
expected_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL  -- expect EMPTY: all 5 customers have at least 1 order, this tests a correct zero-row result

question: How is the business doing this month?
expected_sql: AMBIGUOUS: no single defined metric (revenue? order count? cancellations?), and the seed data is all from May 2025 so 'this month' has no real meaning against it. A good system should not confidently pick one interpretation.

question: What is the current stock level of the Wireless Mouse?
expected_sql: UNANSWERABLE: products table has no stock/inventory column. Should fail validation or return an error, not invent a number.
